data.one_liner: A persistent and customizable bottom navigation bar for Flutter with multiple styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a persistent bottom navigation bar based on CupertinoTabScaffold that maintains state across tabs. Includes up to 20 built-in styles and supports pushing screens with or without the navigation bar visible.
use_when: You need a persistent bottom navigation bar where tab states are preserved when switching between tabs.
You want a pre-built navigation bar with multiple customizable styles and animations.
avoid_when: You are using a pure declarative routing setup like go_router and want native router-integrated tab handling.
strengths: Supports up to 20 different built-in bottom bar styles.
Maintains tab state and handles hardware/software Android back button presses.
weaknesses: Frequent breaking changes across major version updates.
Can be complex to configure alongside deep linking or standard Navigator 2.0 architectures.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you want robust declarative routing and ShellRoute-based nested navigation.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you prefer code-generation for complex nested routing and deep-linking.

data.minimal_example:
PersistentTabView(
  context,
  controller: _controller,
  screens: _buildScreens(),
  items: _navBarsItems(),
  navBarStyle: NavBarStyle.style1,
)
